texts.zh:
粗短结实的机械装置被挤压在一具外骨骼中。工具、零零散散的零件和油腻腻的手都能看出他是个修补匠，他的眼睛里闪烁着好奇和热情。

早啊老板！我叫博林，诺嘉之子。很高兴认识你！
texts.en:
The short and sturdy mechanic is squeezed into an exoskeleton. Tools, scattered parts and greasy hands bear the telltale marks of a tinkerer, and his eyes glint with curiosity and enthusiasm.

Mornin' boss! I'm Borin, son of Noga. Pleased to make your acquaintance!

label.zh: 那么你能为我们做什么？
label.en: So, what can you do for us?

responses.zh:
我是一个有三十年经验的打捞者。这简历就已经够牛逼了吧。你要是有什么东西要建造或者修理，

他用大拇指戳了戳自己的胸口。

我都能搞定。我可不是吹牛，我真的什么东西都能修。而且不只有我一个，我还有一支可以拆解、切割、焊接、收集、修理和组装任何东西的订制机器团队。只要你想的话，给我一队人，我就能服务你整支海军。当然，人手越多越好哇！
responses.en:
Been a salvager for thirty years. I figure that'll do for a resume. You need things built? Something repaired?

He points his thumb at his chest.

I can do it. Not to boast or anything, but I've fixed everything there is to be fixed. And not just me - I've got a team of custom bots to dismantle, cut, weld, gather, repair and reassemble whatever you need. Gimme a crew and I can service your whole navy if you want. The bigger the better as far as I'm concerned.

responses.zh: 我就是满世界跑，为自己谋个出路。你看起来是一个会重视劳动的老板、一位靠谱的领导。你能看清这个世界的本来面目，利用我们所拥有的东西来建设更美好的未来。
responses.en: I'm just trying to make my way in the galaxy. You seem like an employer that values hard work and a steady hand. Someone who sees the world for what it is, taking the things we have and using them to build a better future.

label.zh: 那你为什么从之前的单位离职了？
label.en: Why did you leave your previous job?

responses.zh: 你问真的吗？我腻了。从我记事起，我就梦想在虚空中遨游。我想逼一下自己看看能走多远。所以我就收拾好工具，然后就是现在这样咯。现在，还有别的问题吗？要不我们开建吧！
responses.en: Honestly? I got bored. Ever since I can remember I've dreamed of cruising the void. I want to push myself, see how far I can go. So I packed my tools and here I am. Now, unless you have more questions, what do you say we get building?

tooltips.zh: 博林作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Borin joins our empire as a Leader.

title.en: I Was Born in the Year of ...

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetHisHer]的房间里闭门数月撰写自传，其中不仅有[Root.GetHisHer]自己的毕生经历，还有[Root.GetHeShe]所了解的工程学研究、建设和稀有材料的知识。只要拜读[Root.GetHisHer]的大作，我们的科学家就一定能有所发现。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has spent months in [Root.GetHisHer] cabin writing a self-biography that includes not only [Root.GetHisHer] life story and travels, but also everything [Root.GetHeShe] knows about engineering research, construction, and rare materials. When reviewing his work, our scientists made some interesting discoveries.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]建造了一个机器伙伴，叫做皮瑞里亚。这台机器人具有高级学习能力，并且拥有人格矩阵。它帮助[Root.GetName]进行[Root.GetHisHer]的研究和维修工作。然而，与它的创造者一样，皮瑞里亚也是好奇心满满，渴望着离开家去冒险。[Root.GetName]问我们，皮瑞里亚能不能在我们社会中拥有自主的一席之地？
texts.en: [Root.GetName] built a robot companion named Beryllia. The robot is capable of advanced learning, and has a personality matrix. It is assisting [Root.GetName] with [Root.GetHisHer] research and repair jobs. However, like its creator, Beryllia is curious and longs to leave home to embark on its own adventures. [Root.GetName] wonders if Beryllia could play an autonomous role within our society.

label.en: She has a knack for ships, right?

tooltips.zh: 一位叫皮瑞里亚的机器人舰队司令作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: The robot Admiral Beryllia joins our empire as a Leader.

label.zh: 我们可以把它安排进一些办公室里……
label.en: We can use her in some office...

summary.text:
# 博林 / Borin

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/paragon_events_4.txt:1061-1155、3062-3133, 3137-3210、1728–1866（paragon.41234）、15–160（paragon.40000/40001）· DLC：典范 Galactic Paragons · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

“知名领袖”抽签：每十年（on_decade_pulse_country）隐藏事件 paragon.40000 检查（典范DLC、玩家、非杀戮帝国、已研究外星语言学、近期未招募），按基础1（有招募办公室+2）对“随失败而递增”的权重决定是否在1–360天内抽签（40001）。抽签只放入与本国思潮相符、尚未出现过且未被解雇的领袖；本故事的人物属于**唯物**思潮（renowned_materialist2）。
Renowned leader lottery: each decade hidden paragon.40000 (Paragon, player, not homicidal, Xeno-Linguistics, no recent recruit) may draw within 1–360 days (40001); only leaders matching your ethics, not yet offered and not dismissed are in the pool. This one is **materialist**.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 招募对话：挤在外骨骼里的热情修补匠。可反复询问（只显示回答），然后“解雇”或“招募”。
   Recruitment: an enthusiastic tinkerer in an exoskeleton. Ask questions (replies only), then dismiss or enlist.
2. 招募后，每十年隐藏事件 paragon.41234 随机挑选一名知名领袖，对此人按10%/10%/80%抽取下面两段故事之一或都不发生，延迟1–1800天；两段都只发生一次，可在不同的十年里先后出现。
   After hiring, every decade paragon.41234 picks a renowned leader; for this one 10% / 10% / 80% (nothing), 1–1800 days later. Each episode fires once; both may happen in different decades.

- **鄙人生于…… / I Was Born in the Year of ...**（paragon.41010）：闭门写成自传，里面满是工程知识：按研究进度获得工程研究，或开启巨型工程学科技选项。
  he writes an autobiography full of engineering lore: engineering research, or the Mega-Engineering tech option depending on progress.
- **向皮瑞里亚问好 / Say Hello to Beryllia**（paragon.41020）：他造的机器人伙伴皮瑞里亚：作为舰队司令加入或安排进办公室（修正）。
  his robot companion Beryllia: join as an admiral or work in an office (modifier).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- “解雇”：人物回到全局池，但本国设置 dismissed 标记，以后不会再抽到。“招募”：成为知名领袖（李萨拓等人另带舰队）。
  Dismiss: never offered to you again. Enlist: becomes a renowned leader.
- 两段后续是相互独立的随机事件，不是先后两章；领袖死亡或离开后不再发生。
  The two episodes are independent random events, not chapters in order.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 只有拥有唯物思潮的帝国会被提供此人。后续故事的额外条件见上（括号内）。
  Offered only to materialist empires; extra episode conditions are given in brackets above.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：40000/40001 抽签与权重（01_script_values_paragon.txt ethic_leader_randomizer）、招募事件全部选项、ethic_leader_hire_effect 设置领袖标记、41234 的分派与权重、后续事件的触发条件、选项与项目。
- 更正 Corrections：原先十六名领袖的招募对话被合成一个故事（按抽签器），而所有后续故事又被合成另一个故事；现按人物拆分，每人一则故事，招募后接各自的后续。
  The lottery-based story and the follow-up story were split into one story per leader.
- 不确定 Uncertain：每十年只随机挑选一名知名领袖进行判定，拥有多名知名领袖时后续可能更晚出现。
